display_name: 会话交接与增量记忆 v3（一会话一文件）
description_zh: 跨 agent 的会话增量记忆与交接。每轮把实质结论增量追加到 $LIB/memory/mem_<agent>_<会话>.md（一会话一文件，天然溯源到唯一会话记录；带时间戳与逐字引用），并读取 $LIB/handoff_patches.md 中用户确认过的判据句；$LIB 默认项目内 .handoff3/，可由 root.txt 指向外部记忆库。agent 名须按会话记录实际落在哪个配置根现场判定，禁止按库内已有文件名反推。五个动作：交接（含自检六步 + 补缺口 + 重建视图 + 报告）、更新记忆、自检、基于记忆、帮助。写入只限 $LIB 内，会话记录只读；会话记录被删除或归档后该文件自动转为只读沉淀。结尾按本轮是否碰过 mem 文件二选一落款。
description_en: Cross-agent incremental session memory and handoff. Each turn appends substantive conclusions to $LIB/memory/mem_<agent>_<session>.md — one file per session, so every entry traces to exactly one session record; timestamps and verbatim quotes included — and reads user-approved criteria sentences from $LIB/handoff_patches.md. $LIB defaults to the project's .handoff3/, redirectable to an external library via root.txt. The agent name must be determined live from which config root the session record actually sits in; never infer it from existing mem filenames. Five actions: handoff (six-step self-check + gap fill + view rebuild + report), update memory, self-check, from memory, help. All writes stay inside $LIB; session records are read-only; a file freezes read-only when its session record is deleted or archived. Each turn ends with one of two footers depending on whether a mem file was touched.
